items.detail: Added to the Knicks report Wednesday afternoon as questionable with an illness, worse than the probable the brief has; hold until he is confirmed active for the 7:30 ET tip.
Upgraded from questionable to probable (right knee inflammation) Wednesday afternoon; Josh Hart (shoulder) also upgraded to probable.
Added Wednesday afternoon as questionable with right knee soreness and described as potentially on the wrong side of questionable; Malik Monk and Emanuel Sharp would absorb minutes if he sits.

Still officially questionable (low back tightness) after missing Monday, but a reporter says all indications are he plays and a shootaround photo points the same way; not yet confirmed by the Spurs, so hold until he is active.

Likely reason for the PRA model gap: projected starter in a frontcourt missing Porzingis (not with team), Butler and Moody, with Lendeborg questionable (illness), so his role should exceed the model's 23.9 minutes.

Alex Caruso is off the Thunder injury list and back tonight, which can trim bench wing minutes, while Jaylin Williams (back) and Aday Mara (shin) are out; one earlier report still listed Caruso day-to-day.
Alex Caruso's return from the hip issue adds a guard to OKC's rotation tonight, a risk to Stirtz's minutes for his threes prop; Cason Wallace and Nikola Topic remain out.

note: Evening run. No reason found for the Gobert or Sharpe model gaps; Fox (shin) remains a game-time call as the brief has it.
